cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer who has spent the last few years building NLP systems for medical and academic texts. My PhD work on hybrid evaluation metrics for Turkish summarization required designing deep-learning pipelines, fine-tuning LLMs, and creating robust evaluation frameworks. At Toros University I led a department while managing research projects, which gave me solid experience coordinating engineers and product teams.

I have built end-to-end Python solutions for text extraction, trained models on domain-specific corpora, and deployed them for real users. My recent work on trustworthy AI for clinical systems involved translating scientific advances into production code and monitoring performance over time. These skills match the core tasks of developing and maintaining NLP models for legal documents.

Although my experience is with Turkish and English data, I am fluent in Spanish and have already applied NLP techniques to multilingual contexts. I am ready to learn the specifics of legal language and to contribute to Doctrine's Spanish product.

Thank you for considering my application. I am available to discuss how my background can help advance your AI platform.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
